DrSwarm | CTO Cofounder | Bay Area | Full-time

Building AI agents that automate the work of outpatient healthcare practices.

I'm the former co-founder/CEO of DrChrono (YC W11).

Looking for an exceptional hands-on technical cofounder who wants to build a ton of product — not manage an engineering org. You'll code every day, own the architecture, work directly with customers, and help define what we build.

Python/Django, Next.js, Postgres, AWS, LLM/voice/agent infrastructure.

Bay Area strongly preferred. Cofounder-level equity + salary.

Email: jobs@drswarm.com include CTO in email subject
